L190: cite101†Learn more L191: ## What you will learn
L192: 
L193: Upon successful completion of this program, graduates will be able to:
L194:   * Install and configure computer hardware and software
L195:   * Develop software applications for PC, mobile and embedded devices
L196:   * Create computer software using multiple programming languages
L197:   * Develop intelligent web and mobile applications
L198:   * Integrate cloud-based services and solutions in software apps
L199:   * Apply version control and project management skills in software development
L200:   * Collaborate and communicate effectively in team-based development environment
L201:   * Evaluate and implement new technologies in software development
L202: ## What to expect
L203: ### Program Duration and Maximum Time for Completion
L204: 
L205: This program is 2 years of full-time study. A term break is typically scheduled between year 1 and year 2. The maximum time to complete the program is 5 years.
L206: 
L207: The main mode of delivery for the CST program is face-to-face in a lab setting. Instructional strategies include classroom lectures, demonstrations, group discussions, computer labs and hands-on practical work, and online sessions.
L208: Students have access to state-of-the-art modern computer labs with software and tools such as Visual Studio, Azure Microsoft suite of applications and Operating Systems, web and mobile app development tools, and private department servers.
L209: ## Admission requirements
L210: 
L211: ### Program-specific
L212: 
L213:   * Grade 12 graduation or equivalent
L214:   * English Studies 12 with a minimum 'C' grade, or cite102†equivalent L215:   * Foundation of Mathematics 11 with a minimum 'C+' grade, or cite102†equivalent L216: ### General
L217:   * Seats are offered to applicants who have met all admission requirements, on a first-qualified, first-served basis.
L218:   * International applicants must be 17 years of age or older or a graduate of a secondary school. (Some exceptions may apply.)
L219:   * Applicants must submit cite39†official transcripts and educational documents as required by their course or program.
L220:   * All VCC applicants are required to function successfully in an English-speaking classroom. English requirements vary by program. For details, visit cite38†VCC International - English Requirements .
L221: ### Program Considerations
L222:   * Extended periods (4+ hours) of computer work requiring sustained visual attention to screens. Tasks require frequent keyboarding and mouse use.
L223:   * Students are expected to have access to a modern laptop capable of running Microsoft Windows with full privileges. Required hardware consists of at least a quad-core processor and 16GB of RAM and 256GB storage, in order to do their assignments or connect to the lab computers remotely.
L224:   * Audio/video hardware including webcam/speakers/microphone for participating in classes that have an online delivery mode.
L225: ## Courses *
L226: ### Prior learning assessment and recognition
L227: 
L228: Students may request formal recognition of prior learning attained through informal education, work, or other life experience, including Indigenous ways of knowing. Credits may be granted to students who are able to sufficiently demonstrate the learning outcomes of specific courses.
L229: 
L230: PLAR is available for the following courses:
L231:   * CSTP 1101 Communication and Workplace Behaviour
L232:   * CSTP 1106 Website Development
L233:   * CSTP 1120 Introduction to Computer Systems
L234:   * CSTP 1130 Python Programming
L235:   * CSTP 1150 Applied Mathematics for Programmers
L236: 
L237: Students may complete up to 50% of the total credits of the program through PLAR and transfer credit. Please see individual course outlines for PLAR details. Tuition and fees apply to PLAR.
L238: 
L239: Methods for assessing prior learning may include exams, portfolios, interviews, and other evaluations.
L240: If PLAR is successful, transcripts will reflect an ‘S’ grade (satisfactorily completed), which is not included in grade point average (GPA) calculations.
L241: 
L242: International Students should contact VCC International Education Advising to learn how PLAR can impact immigration status, prior to proceeding with the PLAR request.
L243: 
L244: See cite103†Prior Learning Assessment and Recognition policy for more information.
L245: This full-time program can be completed over four (4) terms by successfully completing the following: 15 credits (term 1), 15 credits (term 2), 14 credits (term 3), 16 credits (term 4).

L299: cite129†Submit Test Scores to VCC L300: # English Entrance Requirements for International Students
L301: 
L302: ­­English is the primary language of instruction at VCC. All applicants are required to demonstrate the appropriate level of English language proficiency to function successfully in an English-speaking classroom.
L303: 
L304: English entrance requirements vary by cite32†programs . Here's how you can check the requirements and equivalencies accepted.
L305:   1. Visit the cite32†program page of your choice, and find out the English grade required for the program.
L306:   2. Refer to the chart below for the common assessments you can use to meet the English language proficiency requirements.
L307:   3. Click on the English grades below to see other equivalencies accepted, such as CAEL, Cambridge, PTE, VCC EAL Accuplacer assessments, University English grade, BC EAP level, and more.
L308:   4. Planning to study English to meet the requirements? Check out the cite125†options available to international students.

L317: #### Test Score Validity
L318: CAEL CE/CAEL Online (Canadian Academic English Language Test), Cambridge Assessment (B2 First (FCE) or C1 Advanced (CAE)), Duolingo English Test, IELTS Academic, PTE Academic/PTE Academic Online (Pearson Test of English) and TOEFL iBT are accepted as cite138†external test options for meeting VCC's English entrance requirements, in addition to cite139†VCC EAL (ESL) Accuplacer + VCC EAL (ESL) Speaking Assessment . English test scores are valid for 2 years.
L319: The test scores must be valid at the time a complete application is received at VCC.
L320: Remember to cite129†submit your test scores to VCC.

L323: #### Countries that satisfy English language proficiency requirements
L324: 
L325: Speaking and listening requirements can be satisfied through secondary or post-secondary education at an accredited institution where English is the medium of instruction and is also one of the country’s official languages.
